Maine Senate Candidate Faces Allegations, Democratic Support Wanes

Democratic Senate candidate Graham Platner is facing allegations of sexual assault. Several prominent Democrats, including the New York City mayor, have called for him to withdraw from the race. The deadline for replacing him on the ballot is approaching, creating urgency for the party.
